medic_tip5432:
**5-4-3-2-1 technique for anxiety:**
Name out loud:
• 5 things you can SEE
• 4 things you can TOUCH
• 3 things you can HEAR
• 2 things you can SMELL
• 1 thing you can TASTE

This anchors your mind to the present. 💙
medic_tipBoxBreathing:
**Box Breathing:**
1. Inhale for 4 seconds
2. Hold for 4 seconds
3. Exhale for 4 seconds
4. Pause for 4 seconds

Repeat 4-6 times. Used by elite forces to stay calm. 🌬️
medic_tipCrisisLines:
**If you're in an emotional crisis:**

🆘 Mexico support lines:
• SAPTEL: 55 5259-8121 (24h)

You're not alone. There are people who want to help you. 💙
medic_tipAntiStress:
**Quick anti-stress techniques:**
• Roll your shoulders in circles
• Cold water on your wrists
• Count backwards from 10
• Make a list of 3 things you're grateful for
• Gently stretch your neck
